note: Numpad notation, facing right: 6 = forward, 4 = back, 2 = down, 8 = up, 236 = quarter circle forward. Craft Gauge: 4 bars (400%), kept between rounds. You build it by landing hits (more) and by being hit or blocking (less); whiffs give nothing, and a move that spends meter gives its user none. After spending meter, gains are cut to a quarter for 3 seconds. Below 35% health it slowly fills by itself. Burst gauge: starts full, kept between rounds, refills over time (faster at low health) and when you're hit.

sections.title: Normals
moves: chains A > B > C; 5C is a long devil-arm punch
rising devil-arm uppercut: launches; any normal cancels into it; jump (8) on hit to chase (no jump cancel on block)

sections.title: Specials
moves: a wave of shadow rolls along the floor
two waves, one after the other
invincible start; a wall of energy pushes slowly forward: three hits, the last throws them sky-high
a black hole opens close in front of him (A) or far away (B); it waits about 5 seconds. Touching it: the near one launches them away, the far one throws them toward him
both holes, invincible start: the far one collapses at once and throws them toward him, into the near one
22 + A / B / C (a hole is open)
finger snap: the holes suck the opponent in and burst; the near one throws them away, the far one toward him
low grab lunge; on hit he drains them and stocks the energy
jumping overhead smash with the devil arm (also in air). Ground version: 214 + B again on hit or block = Abyss Riser
214 + B after Abyss Hammer hits or is blocked
rising uppercut (not an overhead): launches; on hit, air jump or air attacks to keep the combo going
invincible lunge: grabs the face, drains, and the explosion blows them away; stocks the energy
214 + A / B / C (energy stocked, also in air)
with energy stocked, any 214 fires a quick beam (three hits, +15 on block); uses the stock
air grab: drags them down into a ground explosion, then drains them and stocks the energy

sections.title: Supers
moves: charge, ground slam, a storm of purple fire around him, then the last burst throws them away
sliding grab: carries them to the wall, three slams, then a blast that knocks him back onto one knee

sections.title: System
moves: needs a FULL Burst gauge and uses all of it; works in hitstun (not out of every special / EX / super hit). Does no damage, knocks them away
On the ground: dash forward, or back dash with back held. In the air: air dash forward, or back with back held
hold A / B / C (air) or any button (ground)
knocked into the air: holding a button techs as soon as you can (hold forward to tech forward). Knocked down: any button
